paragraphs: JSG Monitoring supplies electronic monitoring equipment and support solutions to courts, law enforcement, probation, parole, attorneys, and voluntary clients nationwide. The catalog covers GPS tracking devices, alcohol monitoring tools, and victim notification systems. Products are described as featuring precise location tracking and tamper-resistant designs.

Listed devices include the OM500, described as a GPS/cellular ankle monitor. Supplier partners operate the monitoring centers that provide support and oversight. Victim notifications are named on the about page as part of customizable monitoring programs.
Tools are described as helping government agencies, law enforcement, and businesses streamline their operations. The company states over 30 years of experience.

quote.text: JSG Monitoring provides a comprehensive suite of electronic monitoring equipment and support solutions tailored to meet the unique requirements of courts, law enforcement, probation, parole, attorneys, and voluntary clients nationwide.
